content: Isirelibɑn bɑndɑ
bɔnu kuɑ yiru
Roboɑmu u dɑ Sikɛmuɔ. Domi Isirelibɑ kpurowɑ bɑ dɑ mi bu kɑ nùn ko sunɔ.
N deemɑ Yeroboɑmu, Nɛbɑtin bii, u rɑɑ kpikiru suɑ Sɑlomɔɔn sɔ̃ u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Eɡibitiɔ. Sɑnɑm mɛ u nuɑ Roboɑmu u bɑndu di, yerɑ u ɡɔsirɑmɑ Eɡibiti min di.
Yerɑ bɑ nùn sɔmɔ ɡɔriɑ bɑ nɛɛ, u nɑ. Ye u tunumɑ, yerɑ wi kɑ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri wɔkuru bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Roboɑmu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ,
wunɛn tundo u sun yoo sɔmɑ koosiɑ, mɑ yɑ sun buniɛ nɡe kɛtɛn suɡu. Adɑmɑ wunɛ ɑ sun tu kɑwo kpɑ su nun swĩi.
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ɡinɑ doo. Ǹ n kuɑ sɔ̃ɔ itɑ kpɑ i wurɑmɑ. Mɑ tɔn be, bɑ doonɑ.
Yerɑ Roboɑmu u Isirelibɑn bukurobu mɛnnɑ win mi, be bɑ rɑ rɑɑ win tundo Sɑlomɔɔ bwisi kɛ̃. Mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, bwisi yirɑ̀ i mɑn kɛ̃mɔ n tɔn be sɔ̃.
Mɑ bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n wurɑ sɑɑ ɡisɔn di, ɑ tɔn be nɔɔri kpɑ ɑ ko ye bɑ nun bikiɑ, kpɑ ɑ bu wisi kɑ kĩru, bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ wunɛn tɔmbu sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Adɑmɑ Roboɑmu wi, u ǹ bukuro ben ɡɑri wure. Win sɑɑrɑsi kɑ be u biru di sɑnnu, berɑ u bwisi bikiɑ.
U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bwisi yirɑ̀ i mɑn kɛ̃mɔ n kɑ tɔn be wisi be bɑ nɛɛ, n bu yoo sɔmɑ kɑwo ye nɛn tundo u rɑɑ bu koosiɑ.
Yerɑ bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, wunɛn niki bii piibu ɡɑ wunɛn tundon pɔrɑ bɔɔrum kere.
Wunɛn tundo u rɑɑ bu yoo sɔmɑ koosiɑ. Mɛyɑ kɑɑ mɑɑ tu sosi. Wunɛn tundo u rɑɑ bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ kɑ yii sɛnnu. Mɛyɑ kɑɑ mɑɑ bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ kɑ som kpɑki.
Yerɑ Yeroboɑmu kɑ tɔn be kpuro bɑ nɑ Roboɑmun mi sɔ̃ɔ itɑse te, nɡe mɛ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ.
Roboɑmu u tɔn be wisɑ kɑ dɑm. U ǹ bukuro ben ɡɑri yi ɡɑrisi ɡɑ̃ɑnu.

Adɑmɑ win sɑɑrɑsi ben bwisiyɑ u kɑ sɔmburu kuɑ, mɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn tundo u rɑɑ bɛɛ yoo sɔmɑ koosiɑ. Adɑmɑ tɛ̃, nɛɡirɑ tɑ koo kerɑ. U rɑɑ bɛɛ sɛɛyɑsiɑ kɑ yii sɛnnu. Adɑmɑ nɛ, som kpɑkiyɑ kon kɑ bɛɛ sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Roboɑmu u yinɑ u tɔn beɡii swɑɑ dɑki, domi Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u derɑ n koorɑ mɛ, kpɑ win ɡɑri yi kɑ koorɑ yi u rɑɑ Yeroboɑmu, Nɛbɑtin bii sɔ̃ɔwɑ sɑɑ Akiyɑ, Siloɡiin nɔɔn di.
Roboɑmu
u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sunɔ
Ye Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ wɑ mɑ sinɑ boko u ǹ ben ɡere swɑɑ dɑki, yerɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: mbɑ n sun mɔɔsinɛ bɛsɛ kɑ Dɑfidi, Isɑin bii.
Sɑ ǹ mɑɑ bɔnu ɡɑɑ mɔ kɑ wi.
Bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ i de su ɡɔsirɑ

content: Mɑ Isireli be, bɑ ɡɔsirɑ bɑ wurɑ ben yɛnusɔ.
Mɑ Roboɑmu u kuɑ Yudɑbɑ tɔnɑn sunɔ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ u Hɑdorɑmu ɡɔrɑ Isirelibɑn mi, wi u rɑ bu kpɑre bu kɑ wɔ̃ɔ ɡobi mwɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn kpenu kɑsukɑ bɑ ɡo. Yerɑ n derɑ Roboɑmun tii u win tɑbu kɛkɛ wɔri fuuku fuuku u dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri wɔku te, tɑ kɑ Dɑfidin yɛnuɡibu kɑrɑnɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔ.
